action: Take the scheduled call with Dr. Kevin Marsh, Workforce Program Director at Millfield Community College, and push for a concrete offer. I am not calling to 'explore' anything. I am calling to negotiate. My ask: a paid advisory role — minimum $2,500 per month — to serve as the external policy architect for the community college's workforce transition programming, specifically the retraining tracks tied to the municipal fund I created. I bring grant design expertise, council relationships, and the retraining fund authorization that makes MCC's programs fundable. If he counters with an unpaid advisory role, I decline. If he offers an instructional stipend, I counter. I need a signed letter of agreement this month, not a second call next month.
